workstream: Wave 3C-1 — Public infrastructure/facility completeness from Makati publications
reason: The original 3C-1 added four readily verifiable government-service assets but did not inventory Makati's own published public-facility network.

countingRule.makatiLguCompleteness: Count verified public-facing Makati LGU/protective/community facilities against source-backed Makati facility families.
countingRule.nationalGovernmentServices: Track separately as supplemental services; never use them to inflate Makati-LGU completeness.
countingRule.formerMakati: Preserve for provenance but exclude from current Makati.
countingRule.unresolved: Do not implement speculative current pins.
countingRule.coLocatedCounters: Do not create separate assets for every department or counter within the same public building unless it functions as a distinct destination.

substeps.title: Verify current public health facilities
substeps.maximumScope: The 18 health-center baseline plus the separately counted 24/7 health center. Verify current name, address, barangay, continuity and coordinate provenance; do not add assets yet.

substeps.title: Verify current protective-service facilities
substeps.maximumScope: 11 fire stations and 8 police facilities. Reconcile post-transfer station identity/numbering and current locations. MAPSA/Bantay Bayan outposts remain a later decision within this step if a reliable named inventory exists.

substeps.title: Reconcile community, social-welfare and city-owned facilities
substeps.maximumScope: Day-care/child-minding network, Social Development Center, Makati Youth Home, Youth Center, Senior Citizen Center, Poblacion Public Market and citywide civic anchors. Resolve the 2020 named list against 2023 current counts.

substeps.title: Implement verified health and protective-service facilities
substeps.splitRule: Implement in bounded source-coherent batches; health, fire and police should not be one giant commit.
substeps.splitReason: Keep coordinate verification and implementation bounded: two 9-site health batches, then fire, then police.

substeps.title: Implement verified community/social/city-owned facilities
substeps.splitRule: Only source-backed current public-facing destinations; no speculative day-care or outpost pins.
substeps.splitReason: Implement core social/city-owned facilities first, then co-location-aware day-care/child-minding assets separately.

substeps.title: Close facility completeness audit
substeps.stopWhen: Every official named facility in the reviewed families has a current, former-Makati, merged/co-located, deferred or unresolved disposition and integrity guards protect the verified current set.

immediateNext.title: Reopen transport completeness using official-source-first reconciliation
immediateNext.maximumScope: Extract Makati-published transport inventories/counts first, crosswalk them against the existing Civic Map/current operators and present-day 23-barangay geography, classify every discrepancy, and stop after reconciliation before implementation.
